attempts.summary: Configured a persistent, secured NFSv4.2 share from node1 to node2. Both nodes use dataops UID/GID 4500; the shared directory is dataops:dataops mode 2770. Two-way access, denial for non-members, cleanup, and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified. RHEL 10.0, the original kernel, SELinux enforcing mode, and firewalld remain intact.
